stage: Exploratory diagnostics; no approved research-question change
author_permission: Explore alternatives; show findings and await explicit approval before adopting a new research question
purpose: Resolve learning and participant-generalization failures before proposing a contribution

deap_normalization_pair.hypothesis: Per-window, per-electrode normalization may reduce participant offsets while retaining discriminative within-window structure
deap_normalization_pair.single_planned_difference: Replace frozen training-channel mean/std with each window/electrode's own mean and RMS
deap_normalization_pair.fixed: Canonical 32 electrodes; recovered valence; 4..40 Hz; non-overlapping 4 s; EEGNet-8,2; seed 42; same participant split, initialization, sampler; fixed Adam 0.001; batch 32; no augmentation; max 100 epochs, min 25, patience 15; same validation checkpoint selection and 0.5 threshold
deap_normalization_pair.primary_selection: Validation trial balanced accuracy, ties lower balanced trial log loss
deap_normalization_pair.development_only: Both runs use a previously inspected test cohort; comparison is diagnostic, not an untouched confirmatory evaluation
deap_normalization_pair.stopping_rule: One normalization run; report the result regardless of direction; no test-based threshold or participant calibration
deap_normalization_pair.unused_artifact: Existing trainer still fits and records the training-channel scaler for verification; window mode does not apply it

native_seediv_diagnostic.purpose: Assess learnable native dataset structure before considering changes to binary pooling
native_seediv_diagnostic.inputs: All 62 named electrodes, all four supplied emotion classes, all 15 participants and three sessions
native_seediv_diagnostic.features: Four-second non-overlapping window log bandpowers in theta 4..8, alpha 8..14, beta 14..31, gamma 31..40 Hz; aggregate within each original trial
native_seediv_diagnostic.split: Five predeclared participant-disjoint outer folds; three test participants, next three validation participants, remaining nine training participants; seed-42 permutation
native_seediv_diagnostic.models: Training-standardized class-balanced multinomial logistic regression, C in [0.01, 0.1, 1, 10], selected using validation macro recall
native_seediv_diagnostic.comparisons: Native 62 vs named common 14 electrodes, and native four-class vs existing coarse binary with neutral excluded; same subject folds; report different chance levels and avoid comparing raw accuracies across tasks
native_seediv_diagnostic.limitations: Trial features differ from neural input. Diagnostic classical baseline, not a replication of a published SEED-IV score. Does not prove a new contribution or determine a pivot by itself.
